name: Create Issue
description: Creates an issue or, where the option to create subtasks is enabled in Jira, a subtask. [See the documentation](https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/jira/platform/rest/v3/api-group-issues/#api-rest-api-3-issue-post)

configurable_props.name: properties
configurable_props.label: Properties
configurable_props.description: Details of issue properties to be added or updated. Please provide an array of objects with keys and values.

configurable_props.name: update
configurable_props.label: Update
configurable_props.description: A Map containing the field name and a list of operations to perform on the issue screen field. Note that fields included here cannot be included in `fields`.

configurable_props.name: additionalProperties
configurable_props.label: Additional properties
configurable_props.description: Extra properties of any type may be provided to this object

configurable_props.name: updateHistory
configurable_props.label: Update History
configurable_props.description: Whether the project in which the issue is created is added to the user's **Recently viewed** project list, as shown under **Projects** in Jira

configurable_props.name: issueTypeId
configurable_props.label: Issue Type
configurable_props.description: An ID identifying the type of issue. [Check the API docs](https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/jira/platform/rest/v3/#api-rest-api-3-issue-post) to see available options
